scope: Only the three stranded members are judged. Parent archives remain CONFIRMED MALWARE.

members.marker_line: golangci-lint installer: ordinary CI download-and-run; rules corrected
Playwright registry: passive npm metadata with CI publisher; no edits
sharp RISC-V registry: passive npm metadata with CI publisher; no edits

recovery: Members were absent from the initial extraction directories. Forager hash retrieval through Hopper, MalwareBazaar, Triage and Malshare did not supply their bytes.

Forager fetched the exact Go module and npm package versions, retaining artifacts and .forage.json provenance in scratch. The installer was extracted from the sum.golang.org-verified module and matched the requested SHA-256.

Hopper /api/sample/<member-sha> retained the registry context and historical numeric facts. /api/provenance/<npm-tarball-sha> and pinned-version Forager records supplied the publication fields. Re-serialization in the historical registry schema, without the later repository_commit field, reproduced both requested hashes exactly. These are exact byte recoveries, not merely substitute current metadata.

installer: Read all 311 bytes and inspected cleave facts, parsed calls and the full tree-sitter pipeline. No obfuscation or encoded stage is present in this member.

set -e -o pipefail aborts on failure. Empty VERSION prints an error and exits before downloading. Otherwise wget -O - -q fetches the HTTPS golangci-lint installer into stdout; sh -s consumes that stream with destination $GOPATH/bin and version v$VERSION. The next command invokes golangci-lint --version.

VERSION and GOPATH occur in the sh argument vector after the pipe. They are not wget arguments. The old wget-var-reference spanned the command boundary. No eval or second parsing of these variables occurs in this script.

This is a CI toolchain helper whose observable effects match its stated lint installation purpose. Remote script execution is a real dual-use capability and remains notable. No credential harvesting, unauthorized transfer, persistence or concealment is supported by this member.

Missing context: actual CI invocation, environment values, downloaded historical installer response and downstream tool bytes. The benign member verdict does not certify those external bytes or the parent archive.
registry_documents: Read both entire documents and their decoded/structural facts. They are flat npm publication records containing inert numbers, booleans, nulls, package identities, descriptions and conventional project URLs, with no executable script or obfuscated embedded payload.

Playwright 1.61.1 declares Microsoft Corporation, playwright.dev and microsoft/playwright. sharp-linux-riscv64 0.35.2 describes the Linux glibc RISC-V native image-processing package, with Lovell Fuller and lovell/sharp provenance.

Both record GitHub Actions as publisher and github.com as publisher email domain. Trusted CI publishing explains publisher_in_maintainers=false; it is not evidence of an account takeover. Release recency is retained as publication metadata.

Missing context: integrity and behavior of the referred package executables, installation on any host and parent-package deployment. These documents do not execute that software, and their benign verdict does not transfer to the dependency payloads.

corrections: Relocated the five generic wget shell-pipeline pipeline atoms and their OR aggregation from objectives/command-and-control/dropper/delivery/pipe to micro-behaviors/process/deploy/interpreter-stdin. Ordinary bootstrap pipelines support a deployment capability, not C2 or malicious delivery. Atomic criticality is notable. Matchers, exclusions, file types and platform scope are preserved.

Updated exact consumers and ancestor OR/exclusion selectors with the exact relocated observation set. No whole-target-directory substitution was used: unrelated curl or Node deployment traits must not become new alternatives. Hostile consumers retain their contextual attack requirements.

Narrowed wget-var-reference at pipe, semicolon and ampersand boundaries. This removes borrowing a later command argument; genuine variable input/output in wget remains detected, including the external hostile cron fixture.

Renamed the raw curl/wget pipeline atom to http-client-pipe-shell-raw-text and corrected its description without changing the matcher or scope. Changed fetch-output-flag-script description to output destination, because -O - selects stdout.
No registry traits needed editing: the current GitHub Actions publisher handling and relocated custody metadata had already corrected the historical takeover findings.

verification.result: 15 fixtures passed. Known positive and benign external fixtures were copied to temporary non-test paths so test-directory exclusions could not make the comparison vacuous.
verification.attack_coverage: Git hook hostile execution, hidden cron/init persistence and raw-IP multi-architecture download/chmod/execution detections remain. All five relocated shell variants retain their original matcher coverage.
verification.controlled_comparison: Normalized old IDs through id-map.json. Relocated external controls lost only the false wget-var-reference on pipe/semicolon/background near misses. No supported behavior was lost.
verification.scan_mode: atomscan --no-update --follow=none --mode slow -f json; no LLM or uploads. Each member was also processed with cleave facts. Full parent archives and all directly analyzed members were compared before/after.
verification.tooling: The inherited CLEAVE_VALIDATE=1 scan mode used an older atomscan-embedded validator which rejected the already-documented 101-rule naming budget. Scans used CLEAVE_VALIDATE=0; final make validate uses the newer standalone release binary with that admitted budget. No trait was weakened to bypass a tool-version mismatch.
verification.scan_warnings: atomscan v2.13.0 reports model v18 versus extractor v19 compatibility; classifier probabilities are therefore bounded by that model/extractor mismatch.
verification.standalone_regression: The same 15 fixtures also passed with /usr/local/var/cyclotron/cleave/target/release/cleave (3.0.0-beta.2), the final validator binary.
verification.validation_corrections: The first make validate found suppression-list limits on CI/CrystalX and repeated ATT&CK mapping. Exact-set exception grouping retained matching populations; the common mapping moved to file defaults.
verification.final_exception_group_rescan: Repeated atomscan on all three members and all three archives after exception grouping; identical trait IDs, criticalities, descriptions, file population and classifier scores to final.scans.json. Retained final2.scans.json in scratch.

remaining_disagreements: None for the three members: all are BENIGN and classifier-benign before and after. Installer risk changes 32 to 4, with its real fetch and interpreter behaviors retained.

This pre-existing parent/dependency coverage limitation does not alter the confirmed verdict or justify inheriting it for the members.
